diagnostic:
D5 CORRECTION, S3 rework. The live-replica gate window is now the constant 40 s and the gate reads no reload setting at all, as ADR-IIS-SKR-003, D5 and L12/L13 fix it. The code change is one change shared with S2: it was made once and recorded on both slices. Recorded here are the two S3 files it touches and the commands it ran.

S3 files, both Modified.
crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/secrets_key_rotation.rs: LiveOpeners loses its per-instance window field and its INTERVALS = 3 and gains two constants of its own - RELOAD_ENVELOPE = 20 s (the K4 envelope) and WINDOW = 2 * BEAT_EVERY + RELOAD_ENVELOPE, with the cadence read where reload.rs owns it. LiveOpeners::at(now) takes the clock alone, so no call site can widen or narrow the window; opens() compares against Self::WINDOW. Its doc states the envelope sizing, the mixed-settings counterexample the refused window answers wrongly, and the K6/Y11/I-28a bound above the envelope. The test module gains T5 and T6 and corrects the shipped beat table.
crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/handlers/secrets_key.rs: four gate_of call sites updated, among them the closure started_over hands store.start_over_secrets_key, so the window the POST re-reads inside its own locked transaction is that same constant and the apply cannot be judged by a different window than the page.
Outside S3's own targets the same change made BEAT_EVERY and REPLICA_STATE_RETENTION pub(crate) where they are (reload.rs, worker.rs) and dropped the Integrations argument of gate_of (handlers/instance.rs); those three files are recorded on S2.

Architectural checks at the declared locator, crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/secrets_key_rotation.rs.
T5, the generated half of L12: the_gate_counts_a_beat_by_the_window_alone, 256 cases, over the writing server's setting 1 ms to 20 s, the reading server's setting 1 ms to one hour and u64::MAX ms, beat ages from one beat ahead of the reading clock (-10 s) to three times the window (120 s), and opens_secrets_key both true and false, generated together. Each case asserts the gate counts the row exactly while the row says it opens the key and the beat is at most the law's 40 s old, where that 40 s is written in the test and never read from LiveOpeners; asserts that 40 s is what 2 x BEAT_EVERY plus the envelope comes to; and, for every writer inside the envelope, recomputes the longest gap that server can leave from the rule of reload.rs itself - BEAT_EVERY rounded up to a whole number of its own reload intervals plus one beat interval of lateness - then asserts that gap plus one whole beat interval still fits the window and that every age inside it reads live. Because the POST re-reads the same gate type, this projection covers the apply as well as the page. the_triples_l12_names_read_the_window_alone pins the must-include triples at both truth values of the row, including the 5000 ms server read 24 s after its beat by a 200 ms reader, the 20 s writer at 39 s and 41 s, equal settings, a reader slower than the writer and a beat ahead of the clock, and spells out that two beat intervals plus the reader's own 200 ms is under 24 s.
T6, L13: the_window_never_outlives_the_hour_a_replica_state_row_is_kept crosses the settings at both ends of the admitted range (1 ms, 200 ms, 5000 ms, 20 s, one hour) on either side and asserts at each pair that the window is 2 x BEAT_EVERY plus the envelope, that it is shorter than REPLICA_STATE_RETENTION read in worker.rs, and that the oldest beat the gate still counts on lies inside that retention. Neither constant is restated beside the gate, and the window the POST re-reads is that same constant.

Each new check was probed by re-injecting the violation: with WINDOW mutated to lose the reload envelope, cargo test -p foundry-app --lib integrations::secrets_key_rotation exits 101 with four failures, the proptest shrinking to writer 1 ms, reader 1 ms, age 20.001 s, opens true. The mutant was applied to the VM copy only and restored before check-arch; the Mac tree never held it.

Commands and observed results, every one in the shared Lima VM through scripts/test-in-lima.sh, each in one foreground invocation wrapped in timeout -k 30 590. cargo fmt then cargo test -p foundry-app --lib integrations::secrets_key_rotation: exit 0, 7 passed, 0 failed. cargo test -p foundry-app --lib integrations::handlers: exit 0, 20 passed, 0 failed, which covers handlers::secrets_key's own tests. The mutant probe: exit 101, 3 passed, 4 failed. cargo xtask check-arch: exit 0, boundary guard PASSED, integrations-seal-fence among the rules it reports. The us-iis-07 lane through eip_warm and eip_lane: exit 0, 1 feature, 32 scenarios all passed, 571 steps all passed, so the S3 fifth run at instance-integration-setup.feature:1532 - the start over confirmed between two words of another server - and S2 run D at :1259, the two RED at f36b357, now pass with no regression elsewhere. cargo xtask smoke on the final Mac bytes: exit 0, "xtask smoke :: all gates green" over fmt --check, clippy, check-arch and the release workspace tests, 94 test binaries, 1259 tests passed, none failed; a first smoke attempt was cut off by the 590 s bound and its status never observed, so the recorded run is the second. The store command scripts/test-in-lima.sh cargo test -p foundry-store --test iis_instance_store was not re-run: this correction changes no file in foundry-store, and the release workspace step of smoke ran that test binary. Nothing was committed and nothing pushed.

Design followed as projected; no contradiction found. No file under crates/foundry-acceptance/, no oracle, support, acceptance, architecture, handoff or ADR file was touched, no test was weakened, skipped or rewritten, and no unit test was added beyond T5, T6 and the corrected shipped table.

Refactors: none. No L1-L4 smell was removed and no responsibility moved, so there is no separate refactor commit.

One deviation from the declared generator note, stated rather than hidden: the proptest runs 256 cases with proptest's default per-run seed and its default source-parallel failure persistence - this repository's convention for every other 256-case property, and the file the mutant run actually wrote, crates/foundry-app/proptest-regressions/integrations/secrets_key_rotation.txt. No pinned seed is set; the law's coverage does not depend on one, and no regression file is needed while the property is green.

typesafe: unavailable. jev_decide.py exits 3 with TYPESAFE_API_KEY absent from this machine's environment, including a login shell. Two choices stayed open and were settled locally: the window as an associated constant rather than a per-instance field, so a per-instance window cannot be built at all, and the property asserting exact equality against an independently written 40 s plus the independently recomputed longest-gap margin rather than against the window the type holds.
